meaning:
ὁδηγός, -οῦ, ὁ
(ὁδός, ἡγέομαι) [in LXX : Est.8:1, Wis.7:15 18:3, 1Ma.4:2, 2Ma.5:15 * ;]
a leader on the way, a guide: Act.1:16. Fig., ὁ. τυφλῶν, Rom.2:19; pl., Mat.15:14 23:16, 24.†
(AS)

elsewhere.note: Leave them alone. They are blind guides of the blind. If the blind guide the blind, both will fall into a pit.”
“Brothers, it was necessary that this Scripture should be fulfilled, which the Holy Spirit spoke before by the mouth of David concerning Judas, who was guide…
